messages:
olivia: Seeing intermittent pod attach failures and some node control-plane flakiness in east2a GPU pool. ~20% of nodes reporting NotReady or network attach errors. Starting a partial zonal peel + traffic reroute. tagging @matt @ryan :warning:

matt: On it. Dumping node status and pod errors now.

olivia: Quick snapshot: `kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep east2a-gpu`
```
ip-10-2-3-45   Ready    gpu=true east2a   4g/8g
ip-10-2-3-56   NotReady kubelet net error
ip-10-2-3-78   Ready    gpu=true east2a   6g/8g
ip-10-2-3-99   Unknown  attach error
```

ryan: Net team alerted. Telemetry shows intermittent egress errors from east2a to the transit router (MTU errors + ICMP fragmentation). Could be a router config or vendor patch rollout upstream.

anita: Prefer to peel a controlled subset and keep a warm buffer. Suggest we drain only nodes with `attach error` annotation and leave `warm=true` pool alone. Use label `peelable=true` for eligible pods.

infra-bot: Suggestion: shift ~25% traffic to east2b, enable smaller-instance fallback for low-priority batch jobs, and ramp drains at 3 nodes / 10 min.

olivia: Proceeding with gentle drains. Steps: `kubectl cordon <node>` then `kubectl drain <node> --delete-local-data --ignore-daemonsets --force`. Doing 3 nodes at a time to avoid mass KV cache misses.

matt: Also lowering per-host batch config to reduce KV cache churn: patching `REDWOOD_BATCH_MAX=8 -> 4` on runtime config for east2a.

sasha: Started weight updates in envoy: pool-east2a-gpu weight 1.0 -> 0.6, pool-east2b-gpu weight +0.4. Monitoring RT and error rates.

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled: route-service/weights update by sasha at 2026-03-18T12:34:00 (canary 10% -> 100% in 5m).

ryan: Net ops found a mismatched MTU on the transit router config (9900 vs 1500). Pushing consistent MTU and will observe for drops. Running NIC checks across affected nodes now.

olivia: Good catch. Keep an eye on pod churn and per-token latency. If usable GPU capacity drops below 70% we trigger emergency west1 scale and further traffic shift.

anita: Adding a temp autoscale rule: when usable_capacity < 0.70, scale_add 8 GPUs in west1 and mark batch jobs as preemptible. I'll push the policy now.

matt: Log snippets from node attach: `error: attach timeout: i/o timeout` on 12 nodes. After draining 3 nodes, attach errors dropped ~30%.

sasha: 95th latency graph: 120ms -> 240ms during initial weight shift, stabilized to ~140ms after east2b ramp. No significant error spike now.

olivia: Plan holds: finish peel over next 40m, validate KV warm after each drain group, revert weights if we see regression. Update every 10m.

olivia: Final for now — thanks all. Will draft incident summary and follow-up action items (router config, longer-term drainage runbook). :thumbsup:
